component.name: LGL System Loadout
component.summary: Guided setup wizard for Fedora gaming, content creation, and development

description.p: LGL System Loadout gets a fresh Fedora install ready for gaming, content creation, and development - without the terminal. Pick exactly what you want from a curated list, click Install, and you are done.
Nothing is selected by default. Every item shows whether it is already installed before you commit. One password prompt covers the entire installation.
LGL Tool Kit now uses the shared LGL Toolkit COPR.

ul.li: LGL Tool Kit apps install from the linuxgamerlife/lgl-toolkit COPR
LGL SCXCTL Manager renamed to LGL Scheduler Manager
New: LGL Keychron Helper
Libvirt clients now install the local QEMU daemon runtime before service and group setup
VM Curator now installs QEMU's SDL display module
VM Curator now installs its common Fedora runtime support and adds the target user to the kvm group
Libvirt setup now runs only when a libvirt-based tool is selected
Installing virt-viewer alone no longer enables the local libvirt daemon
Added Microsoft Edge and Helium to Browsers
Added cbonsai and podman to System Tools
Added LGL Papercutter to LGL Tool Kit
Added VM Curator to Virtualisation
Removed the KineticWE page — no longer supported
Fixed Flatpak installs failing for Flatseal, Zed, and GitHub Desktop
Fixed Tenacity never actually installing despite being selectable
Fixed reboot buttons on the Update and Done pages not triggering polkit
Fixed Flatpak install-detection missing Fedora's ESR-branded Thunderbird build
Fixed a "could not connect to helper socket" error when accepting the Flatpak update prompt on the System Update page
Fixed app icon losing transparency (background baked in as opaque white instead of transparent)

description.p: LGL Tool Kit, KineticWE, and a reorganised Development Tools / Gaming / System Tools layout.

ul.li: New "LGL Tool Kit" page — LGL SCXCTL Manager, LGL DNF Helper, LGL Emoji Picker, LGL Colour Picker, LGL Power Profile Manager, replacing the standalone SCX Scheduler Tools page
New "KineticWE" page (COPR), with an IMPORTANT notice about it obsoleting stock KWin packages
"Python & CLI Dev Tools" page renamed to "Development Tools"; added Zed and GitHub Desktop
tldr moved to System Tools, yt-dlp moved to Content Creation
System Tools split into CLI/GUI sections; Faugus Game Launcher added to Gaming; Tenacity and LibreOffice added
Flatpak update step added to System Update page
Fixed Reboot Now button on Done page doing nothing on failure
Fixed mesa-vulkan-drivers to use the RPM Fusion freeworld variant on Fedora 44+
Fedora 44 support added
Bootstrap now uses python3-dnf5-plugins instead of dnf-plugins-core (correct DNF5 package for Fedora 43+)
Added kernel-modules-extra for controller and input device support
Fixed Flatpak progress output spamming the log
Fixed clipboard buttons on Done page for Wayland
Fixed graphical artifact during Flatpak installs
Improved first launch reliability after install from Discover
Metainfo file renamed to reverse-DNS format to match component ID and desktop file
Desktop file renamed to reverse-DNS format to satisfy AppStream validation
Fixed AppStream metadata component ID so the app appears correctly in Discover
Fixed Panel Colorizer download failing due to spaces in temp directory path
Fixed Panel Colorizer log showing garbled binary text
Fixed KZones download failing due to same space-in-path issue
Fixed kernel warning box overlapping log output on System Update page
Clarified reboot confirmation dialog wording
Added Secure Boot warning on CachyOS Kernel page
